note: Voices: how Afterglow's replies sound. A preset is a named bundle of the served steering dials (dials.json: concise, formal, decisive; the scales are each dial's tested ones, positive or negative end). A custom voice is a control vector of its own, fitted by re:dvx from the user's one-sentence description (steering/voices/<slug>/voice.json; listed under custom once it is ready). The user picks one voice; it applies from the next message (app/afterglow/dials.py). asks_first and abstention are measured, never dials.

presets.label: Default
presets.line: Glimmer as it is: no dials.
